$comment: The ratchet ledger: every number that gates this repository, and the record of how it got there. The gates read their number from here — a value this ledger does not account for is refused, so moving a threshold is a recorded act (from, to, date, reason) that shows up in a diff, not a quiet edit of a constant. The rules live in scripts/ratchet-ledger.mjs; the gates that read it are scripts/audit-test-types.mjs, scripts/audit-test-type-errors.mjs, scripts/audit-implicit-any.mjs and scripts/audit-explicit-any.mjs.

baseline.reason: baseline — the number of test files that carry // @ts-check today; the floor may only rise unless a change says otherwise
